heading: You felt it.
Your phone didn't.
beats.caption: You felt your phone vibrate.
beats.operation: Contrast felt sensation with device state.
beats.before: A pocket buzz seems to mean the phone vibrated.
beats.initial: Photographic denim hip large in frame; pocket focal point; crisp caption in composed negative space.
beats.intermediate: A bright source-local ink mark denotes FELT BUZZ, not physical device displacement.
beats.resolved: Phone itself remains registered and motionless; cut to inspection.
beats.inheritance: Same black phone and pocket location.
beats.sound: Short existing cue for subjective sensation; label as designed sound, not recording.
beats.risk: Do not shake the phone; no halo or caption quiet lane.

heading: You check.
Nothing.
beats.caption: Sometimes, the phone never vibrated at all.
beats.operation: Inspect a separate photographic hand-held phone; clean original notification status overlay.
beats.initial: Phone screen dominates, same black hardware class.
beats.intermediate: Camera approaches screen; a crisp empty-status field becomes legible.
beats.resolved: Small factual qualifier: an empty screen alone is not proof. Narration identifies the illustrative phantom scenario.
beats.inheritance: Phone contour becomes a stable reference for the term.
beats.sound: Existing handling cue, small restrained tick on empty status.
beats.risk: No fake OS screenshots; no unreadable tiny UI; blank screen alone is not evidence.

heading: Phantom
vibration.
beats.caption: That experience is called a phantom vibration.
beats.operation: Separate sensed event from device event using the same photographs.
beats.initial: Hip/photo on one side and phone inspection on the other, unequal scale.
beats.intermediate: Two crisp attached labels: FELT / DEVICE STILL.
beats.resolved: Name describes the discrepancy; hold to read.
beats.inheritance: Distinction FELT versus DEVICE carries into explanation.
beats.risk: No ghost phone glow or blur silhouette; label is conceptual.

heading: A sensation.
A familiar guess.
beats.caption: One proposed explanation starts with what you expect.
beats.operation: Select pocket fabric detail and change interpretation while retaining the identical underlying image.
beats.before: The phone must be the source.
beats.initial: Denim/hand macro; original physical source stays sharp.
beats.intermediate: A source-local selection isolates fabric contact; label POSSIBLE INPUT.
beats.resolved: The candidate acquires the interpreted label PHONE BUZZ? while source pixels remain unchanged.
beats.inheritance: Same selected fabric and sensed-event mark.
beats.sound: Existing soft cloth/paper movement; no invented electrical zap.
beats.risk: Visible PROPOSED EXPLANATION and possible-trigger qualifiers; no deterministic brain pathway.

heading: Expected alert.
Possible false alarm.
beats.caption: Your brain may interpret another sensation as the familiar buzz.
beats.operation: Compare the same ambiguous cue under two labels; phone remains still.
beats.before: The feeling and source are equivalent.
beats.initial: Stable fabric detail plus small stationary phone image.
beats.intermediate: Crisp printed label changes from clothing pressure? to phone buzz?; no image deformation.
beats.resolved: Expectation and interpretation are explicitly tentative, not measured neural anatomy.
beats.inheritance: Question mark persists into evidence qualification.
beats.sound: Existing marker cue on changed interpretation; selective music duck.
beats.risk: Do not imply experiments proved candidate sensation caused this individual's experience.

heading: Reported.
Not explained.
beats.caption: Surveys document the experience; they don't prove that mechanism.
beats.operation: Contrast what the survey counted with what it did not test.
beats.before: An attractive mechanism animation could look like settled proof.
beats.initial: Original summary of study finding, no copied journal imagery.
beats.intermediate: 115 /169 medical staff respondents appears with denominator context.
beats.resolved: Separate explicit line: CAUSE NOT ESTABLISHED BY THIS SURVEY.
beats.sound: Existing evidence-lock cue, score briefly thins for qualification.
beats.risk: No universal prevalence claim; no fake article page or NC source pixels.

heading: A real feeling.
An absent alert.
beats.caption: The sensation can feel real even when the alert wasn't.
beats.operation: Return to the opening pocket, keeping felt-event and physical device distinct.
beats.before: A convincing sensation means the hardware buzzed.
beats.intermediate: FELT stays visible; DEVICE VIBRATION is explicitly absent in this illustrative scenario.
beats.resolved: Phone cutout remains still; camera resolves on the pocket before exact locked ending.
beats.inheritance: Opening image returns with revised understanding; then unchanged london-bridge-v1 ending.
beats.sound: Warm existing resolution cue; score cadence follows complete final word.
beats.risk: Do not clip wasn't or fade early; no long empty brand tail.
